```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.5)
library(ceakit)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
esc <- function(d) { d <- as.data.frame(d); d[] <- lapply(d, function(x) if (is.character(x)) gsub("$", "\\$", x, fixed = TRUE) else x); d }
kbl <- function(d, ...) knitr::kable(esc(d), ...)
results <- readRDS(params$results)
proj <- load_project(".")
P <- proj$params
labels <- setNames(dplyr::coalesce(P$label, P$parameter), P$parameter)
n_dummy <- sum(P$status == "DUMMY", na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r dummy-warning, results = "asis"}
if (n_dummy) cat(sprintf("> **Draft:** %d of %d inputs are still DUMMY placeholders. Results are illustrative only.\n\n", n_dummy, nrow(P)))
```

Structured to follow the CHEERS 2022 reporting checklist. Text in *italics* is a prompt to replace.

# Methods

**Population, setting and location.** *Describe the population, setting and country.*

**Comparators.** `r paste(unique(unlist(lapply(results, function(r) r$arms))), collapse = "; ")`.

**Perspective.** *e.g. health-care payer.*  **Time horizon.** *e.g. lifetime.*

**Discounting.** *State annual discount rates for costs and outcomes.*

**Model.** *Describe the structure (decision tree at screening + Markov states), cycle length, half-cycle correction and key assumptions.* Willingness to pay: `r fmt(results[[1]]$settings$wtp)` per `r results[[1]]$analysis$effect_label`. Probabilistic analysis: `r fmt(results[[1]]$settings$n_sim)` simulations.

## Model inputs

```{r params}
kbl(P[, intersect(c("label", "value", "dist", "se", "n", "unit", "source", "status"), names(P))],
             digits = 4, caption = "Model inputs with distributions used in the PSA")
```

# Results

```{r results, results = "asis"}
for (r in results) {
  cat("\n\n## ", r$analysis$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(kbl(r$wide, caption = paste("Base case (95% uncertainty intervals,", r$analysis$unit, ")")))
  cat("\n\n")
  inc <- r$incremental; inc$icer <- fmt(inc$icer); inc$cost <- fmt(inc$cost, 2); inc$effect <- fmt(inc$effect, 4)
  print(kbl(inc, caption = "Incremental analysis"))
  cat("\n\n")
  print(plot_metrics(r))
}
```

# Uncertainty

```{r uncertainty, results = "asis", fig.height = 5}
for (r in results) {
  cat("\n\n## ", r$analysis$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (p in list(plot_ce_plane(r), plot_ceac(r), plot_tornado(r, labels), plot_evpi(r), plot_evppi(r, labels)))
    if (!is.null(p)) { print(p); cat("\n\n") }
  if (!is.null(r$scenarios)) {
    sc <- r$scenarios; sc$icer <- fmt(sc$icer); sc$cost <- fmt(sc$cost, 2); sc$effect <- fmt(sc$effect, 4)
    print(kbl(sc[, c("scenario", "arm", "cost", "effect", "icer")], caption = "Scenario analyses"))
  }
}
```

# Discussion

*Summarise findings, limitations, generalisability and how uncertainty affects the decision.*

# CHEERS 2022 checklist

```{r cheers}
items <- c("Title", "Abstract", "Background and objectives", "Health economic analysis plan",
  "Study population", "Setting and location", "Comparators", "Perspective", "Time horizon",
  "Discount rate", "Selection of outcomes", "Measurement of outcomes", "Valuation of outcomes",
  "Measurement and valuation of resources and costs", "Currency, price date, and conversion",
  "Rationale and description of model", "Analytics and assumptions", "Characterising heterogeneity",
  "Characterising distributional effects", "Characterising uncertainty",
  "Approach to engagement with patients and others affected by the study", "Study parameters",
  "Summary of main results", "Effect of uncertainty",
  "Effect of engagement with patients and others affected by the study",
  "Study findings, limitations, generalisability, and current knowledge", "Source of funding",
  "Conflicts of interest")
knitr::kable(data.frame(Item = seq_along(items), Topic = items, `Reported in` = "", check.names = FALSE),
             caption = "CHEERS 2022 items (check wording against the published statement)")
```
